collections.name: Murray Franklyn
collections.description: County sale associations for seller names containing Murray Franklyn or the Murray Franklin spelling variant plus an explicit homes, development, land-acquisition, west, or incorporated business term, 1976–September 4, 2026. These associations do not certify the original builder.

collections.name: CamWest
collections.description: County sale associations for seller names containing CamWest or Cam West plus an explicit development, homes, incorporated, LLC, or named-project business term, through September 4, 2026. These associations do not certify the original builder.

collections.name: Quadrant Homes
collections.description: Initial collection covers five reviewed corporate-name forms through 2020. Misspellings, other entities, combined sellers and 2021 onward transactions await review. Tri Pointe successor transactions are not automatically attributed to the historical Quadrant brand.

collections.name: Conner Homes
collections.description: County sale associations limited to explicit Conner Homes, Conner Development, or Conner-Jarvis seller names through September 4, 2026. Generic Conner surname matches are excluded.

collections.name: Toll Brothers
collections.description: County sale associations for explicit Toll Brothers or Toll Bros seller names through September 4, 2026. These associations do not certify the original builder.

collections.name: MainVue Homes
collections.description: County sale associations for explicit MainVue or Main Vue seller names through September 4, 2026. These associations do not certify the original builder.

collections.name: Lennar
collections.description: County sale associations limited to explicit Lennar Northwest seller names through September 4, 2026. Lennart and other surname lookalikes are excluded.

coverage: A partial view of homes linked to nine builder collections across King County. Coverage varies by builder, and a match does not confirm who built the current structure.
evidenceScope: King County home addresses with reviewed historical builder-company sale or deed associations. A match does not confirm who built the current structure.
geometryDescription: Approximate county parcel centers matched by parcel number, street address, and ZIP. These are not surveyed building locations.
researchWindowDescription: County sale records reviewed from 1976 through September 4, 2026. The 2026 period is incomplete.

reviewFlagDescriptions.chronology-review: The county construction year is at least three years after the earliest matching company recording. Structure identity and construction history need review; rebuilding is not established.
reviewFlagDescriptions.land-only-evidence: Supporting Assessor sales include residential land-only classifications and no residential improved-property classification. This does not establish who built the current structure.
reviewFlagDescriptions.legal-corroboration-missing: The complete plat, lot, and block combination was not independently corroborated. The verified association uses the Assessor recording-to-parcel crosswalk.
reviewFlagDescriptions.minor-chronology-gap: The county construction year is one or two years after the earliest matching company recording. This date difference alone does not establish rebuilding or a different builder.
reviewFlagDescriptions.multi-parcel-recording: The Assessor links a supporting recording to more than one parcel. Each home remains a distinct PIN.
reviewFlagDescriptions.recording-crosswalk: The Assessor recording-to-parcel crosswalk differs from the recorder index PIN. The verified address uses the Assessor crosswalk.
reviewFlagDescriptions.assessor-sale-association: The Assessor directly associates this PIN with a sale by a reviewed company name. The deed image and original builder have not been independently confirmed.
reviewFlagDescriptions.gis-primary-address-recovery: The released street, ZIP, postal city and parcel center use the county-designated primary GIS address because the Residential Building address was missing or did not match.

buchan.heldRecoveryDescription: GIS-ZIP recovery candidates from the prior assessment remain outside this release pending validation.
